events.content:
Enabled Cache Components and partial prefetching. Product lookups are now cached by slug and currency for reuse across requests, while the [product page](/workspace/app/products/[slug]/page.tsx) sends the shop frame first, then product details, then related products through separate Suspense boundaries. No route opt-outs were added.

The final `npm run build` passed and reported the product route as partially prerendered. Checks against the production server confirmed the expected EUR and USD prices and that related items arrive after the product details.
